label: Factory Vote
description: Lets players vote for a factory listed in baseq3/factories.txt. A matching <factory>.cfg in the plugins folder is run when the vote passes, and restore.cfg can reset the settings afterwards.

commands.name: factoryvote
commands.description: List factories, or start a vote for the numbered one.

commands.name: fv
commands.description: List factories, or start a vote for the numbered one.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Show the factory set on the server and in the plugin.

commands.name: restorecfg
commands.description: Run restore.cfg to reset cvars to their defaults (level set by ql_restorecfg_perm).

cvars.label: !restorecfg permission
cvars.description: Permission level needed for !restorecfg: 0 everyone, 1 regular, 2 mod, 3 admin, 4 superadmin. Read when the plugin loads.
